Telangana Minister Seeks NOC from Chhattisgarh for Irrigation Project

Telangana Irrigation Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy has requested Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai to grant a No Objection Certificate (NOC) for the Sammakka Sagar irrigation project. The project, located on the Godavari river, requires clearance from Chhattisgarh as it involves water sharing and potential impact on downstream areas. Reddy emphasized the project's importance for Telangana's agricultural sector and urged for cooperation to expedite the process.
